==Vector graphics==
[[Vector graphics]] software can be used for manual graphing or for editing the output of another program; see:
* [[:Category:Vector graphics editors]]
* [[Comparison of vector graphics editors]]
Some online editors using vector graphics for specific needs exist.{{citation needed|date=December 2015}} These creative [[Interface (computing)|interfaces]] work well together with [[data visualization]] tools like the ones above.{{citation needed|date=December 2015}}
